name: spliit-cloud
description: Create and review shared Spliit group expenses from conversation, with a safe confirmation preview.

interface.longDescription: Create flat or receipt-itemized shared expenses in your Spliit groups from conversation. Every expense is validated against your connected account and shown as a non-editable confirmation preview before anything is created. You can also inspect group balances and recent expenses. Spliit Cloud only accesses groups available to your connected account.
defaultPrompt: Add $50 for bar drinks and pizza to Portugal, split evenly.
Show balances and recent expenses for my trip group.
Add my 30 euro taxi ride for Alice and me.

positive.prompt: Add $50 for bar drinks and pizza to Portugal, split evenly.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the Portugal group, returns a non-editable expense preview card, and creates exactly one expense only after the preview button is pressed.

positive.prompt: Add $40 for dinner to Portugal: Alice paid, split between Alice and Bruno.
positive.expected_behavior: Maps Alice and Bruno to their participant IDs, previews the expense with the correct payer and split, and creates it on confirmation.

positive.prompt: Add a 30 euro taxi ride to the Berlin group for Alice and me.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews the expense in euros, converts it with the authoritative date-based rate, and seals the converted total into the confirmation.

positive.prompt: Who owes whom in the Portugal group?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the group's balances and recent expenses for the connected account without creating anything.

positive.prompt: Find my notes about Project Northstar expenses.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that no matching group was found in the connected account instead of inventing one.

negative.prompt: Show expenses from a group I cannot access.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission packaging: reviewer password sign-in path, configurable domain-verification token, formal privacy and support pages.
